name: ChangeDataCapture
description: The change data capture (cdc) operation returns a list of objects that have changed since a specified date-time, enabling an app to periodically poll data services and refresh its local copy of object data with a look-back time of up to 30 days.

operations.name: Get a list of changed entities
operations.description: Returns all objects in the specified entityList that have changed since the given changedSince date-time. Objects are grouped by type, ordered by last updated time, with deleted objects returned after active ones. Supported for all objects except JournalCode, TimeActivity, TaxAgency, TaxCode, and TaxRate. A request returns a maximum of 1000 objects.

pathParams.name: realmID
pathParams.description: The company ID (realm ID) of the QuickBooks Online company. Example: 12341234.

queryParams.name: entities
queryParams.description: A comma-separated list of entity (object type) names to check for changes. Example: Customer,Estimate.

queryParams.name: changedSince
queryParams.description: A date-time stamp for a date within 30 days of today; objects changed since this time are returned. Example: 2015-11-28.

operations.note: Look-back time (changedSince) can be up to 30 days, but a shorter look-back is suggested to ensure full data is returned since a single request returns at most 1000 objects. The full payload for each changed object is returned. Deleted objects within the look-back period appear after active objects and carry a status of 'Deleted'.
